verdict.summary: No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect was found in round 3. The round-2 fix remains intact: registry-named crates are enumerated even with no feature-matrix leg, their manifests and declared features are validated, workspace-default execution is credited consistently, and stale entries cannot disappear merely by deleting a crate's last fragment. The focused zero-leg, stale-entry, live-gap, default-on, implied-feature, malformed-registry, and fail-closed manifest tests exercise the real enforcement path; all 72 scanner tests pass. The live --enforce invocation could not run in this checkout because PyYAML is absent, which is an environment dependency installed by the workflow and not a change defect. With no prior or current findings, progress is stagnant under the mandated comparison scale.
